Completed the three requested feasibility experiments. PHRF is not shown statistically fundamentally flawed; the tested broad-domain bounded configurations fail coverage while local original-observation certificates succeed. This is not an impossibility theorem for every eight-reference placement. Exploratory fixed-shape coverage under two predeclared eight-reference banks is poor even when all eight references are compared offline. N=30 corners cover 0/64 original-amplitude targets at both 48/96 seconds; quarters cover 4/64 and 11/64. N=300 corners cover 0/32; quarters cover 0/32 and 2/32. The target remains relative amplitude L2 <=1e-3. Exact prepared-vs-original counts improve from 30/64 to 58/64 (N=30) and 16/32 to 28/32 (N=300) when support grows. Basis/representation error is recorded separately from corrected-readout error and analytic tail truncation. All eight coverage ScenarioResults are Fail. Offline best-of-eight is not a legal <=2-reference router; no decoder or independent scientific confirmation runs in this experiment.

At N=1200, 48-second preparation succeeds (reported shared reference bytes 204786040; retained preparation doubles 9116727). The 96-second attempt needs 24022669 retained values and refuses the unchanged 16000000 cap. These are scoped storage receipts, not engine peak memory. No new complete B0 throughput result exists; previous incomplete attempts remain the evidence. The frozen <=8 references, <=2 evaluated per voxel, one correction, certification and 256 MiB/120-second caps are unchanged. A 120-second undershoot peak is permitted by the default chart despite 48-second support; simply extending support does not fit the current stress storage budget.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-neighborhoods-20261007/README.md on local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007, source base 101c5ab6; hashes verified. Gale generic outward exponential and validated reference-system bounds are in 62c0aeb3374557874a17f870c9ae05e3290c21cf (https://github.com/canardlapin/gale/pull/24, merged); ScalaFIM pins that topic revision without unrelated optimizer additions. Full fit tests pass: 707 JVM / 649 Scala.js; new observation/neighborhood laws, N=1200 integration, all 80 recovery reference cases with unchanged tolerances, and targeted comparison tests pass on both platforms. scalafimCompileAll passes without compiler warnings. Numerical/scientific/production qualification remain distinct. No ScalaFIM merge or publication.

Next: settle a scientifically supported domain/support and reference placement, then require fresh coverage before another throughput sweep. PHRF-11 remains review; PHRF-14/33 open; epic doing.
